==Summary==

{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

[[Perrin Aybara]] is sitting a few miles south of [[Dumai's Wells]] and contemplating. Today is [[High Chasaline]], a festival where one should think about the good and happy things in one's life. He finds that very difficult to do. He feels guilty about having led a lot of [[wolves]] to their deaths. The [[Aiel]] pester him with messages carried by naked [[Shaido]] ''[[gai'shain]]'' because they like to watch him stammer and blush. Perrin watches the [[White Tower|Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]] under guard by [[Asha'man]] and their [[Warder]]s under guard by [[Mayene]]rs. The Aes Sedai do their best to ignore the [[stilling|stilled]] Sisters in their midst.

[[Aram]] suggests killing the Aes Sedai to take that problem off [[Rand]]'s shoulders. Perrin forbids him to speak of it again. [[Jondyn Barran]] also mentions that it would be better if the Aes Sedai were dead, which makes Perrin start to fret.

Perrin fears that the temporary alliance between [[Aiel]], [[Cairhien]]in, and Mayeners will soon break apart. The [[Asha'man]] and the [[Wise One]]s add their negative feelings towards the Aes Sedai and each other to the situation, too.

[[Loial]] is also uneasy with the situation of keeping the Aes Sedai prisoners.
